name: Great Aegis
primary:
A great shield charm. A golden dome of radius 6 rises where you stand for 10 s:
• You and allies inside get resistance I
• Foes can't get in: they are pushed out and take 0.5 ❤ arcane once a second while touching it
• Hostile projectiles bounce off the dome and now count as yours
self_description: A smaller dome of radius 3.5 moves with you.
